systemd.fgos-mailbox-sync-79903f0c.service:
# fgos-managed: mailbox-sync-timer
[Unit]
Description=fgOS mailbox sync (takes mail from other machines)

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart="/opt/fgos/bin/fgos" hook mailbox-sync --dir "/proj" --remote "origin"
systemd.fgos-mailbox-sync-79903f0c.timer:
# fgos-managed: mailbox-sync-timer
[Unit]
Description=fgOS mailbox sync timer

[Timer]
OnBootSec=60
OnUnitActiveSec=300

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target

launchd.dev.fgos.fgos-mailbox-sync-79903f0c.plis:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!-- fgos-managed: mailbox-sync-timer -->
<!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
<plist version="1.0">
<dict>
  <key>Label</key><string>dev.fgos.fgos-mailbox-sync-79903f0c</string>
  <key>ProgramArguments</key>
  <array>
    <string>/opt/fgos/bin/fgos</string>
    <string>hook</string>
    <string>mailbox-sync</string>
    <string>--dir</string>
    <string>/proj</string>
    <string>--remote</string>
    <string>origin</string>
  </array>
  <key>StartInterval</key><integer>300</integer>
  <key>RunAtLoad</key><true/>
</dict>
</plist>

systemd.fgos-account-probe-79903f0c.service:
# fgos-managed: account-probe-timer
[Unit]
Description=fgOS account probe (calls each provider account directly and records what it found)

[Service]
Type=oneshot
Environment="PATH=/home/u/.local/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin"
ExecStart="/opt/fgos/bin/fgos" dispatch probe-account --all --record --leg direct --dir "/proj"
systemd.fgos-account-probe-79903f0c.timer:
# fgos-managed: account-probe-timer
[Unit]
Description=fgOS account probe timer

[Timer]
OnBootSec=60
OnUnitActiveSec=21600

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
